about: Expected holds of the world answer key (KPC owner, 2026-11-11). Read ONLY by `kpc_world_key_join.py expected` in the plan job of kpc-world-key.yml, and only from a file named *.approved.json. A country listed here is NOT built when it has a reason, a real person's sign-off (approved_by names Brandon / KZ4CP or another person in KPC_PERSONS; the display form 'Brandon (KZ4CP)' counts; 'KPC owner' is not a signature), a source, an approved_date that is a real date not in the future, a copy_sha256 that is the sha256 of that country's saved copy W-<CC>.json.gz, and no passed review_by date: it keeps its previous join on main (key, review, tracts, outlines, index row and review-file rows) and the run can finish green. The plan job checks the bound sha against the current boundary-cache copy; a changed or missing copy does not inherit the hold. Any other entry is ignored and the country is built as normal. A country with no joined park on main cannot be held (the run stops red). Remove a country here to rebuild it.

MT.reason: Saved copy W-MT holds 14 N2K records, but the current MT key joins 39 (27 Ambjent Malta FeatureServer/36, which is not on the box, plus 12 N2K SPA), so the master gate moves the copy aside. Its 14-record baseline is not signed. Owner decision t1419u (Nov 11, 2026): sign MT as an expected hold; do not sign a 14-record baseline. Quality #179 put MT back on this list (Brandon gave Quality that call, 2026-11-12); the owner hand files (30+14=44) still need a graded world build before a hold removal is considered again.

JP.reason: A store-mode rebuild of Japan joins 184 parks against 185 on main, so the never-worse guard keeps main's key and the run goes red every night. All five lost joins (JP-0025, JP-1071, JP-1681, JP-1745, JP-2097) come from the MLIT natural park areas (A10) layer and were made by the pin-inside-only path, and at least two join the wrong place (JP-2097 Kannourako Kaigan Ryokuchi to Muroto-Anan; JP-1071 Goshozan to the Zaou range). Owner decision 2026-11-16: hold Japan until the joins are right. The A10 crosswalk is the proper fix for these pins and stays off until its licence is signed; the owner also ruled the same day that Japan gets no looser pin rule than any other country, which will drop about 102 more joins when it is built. Japan keeps its previous join meanwhile and the run can finish green.
JP.source: Owner, 2026-11-16 6:15 PM CT: 'yes hold it till we get the joins right'; the five lost joins read from world key run 43949001506
